title: 第13章 搬救兵1-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》
content:
第(1/3)页

    吴姜大怒，一个鬼居然敢看不起他，自己可是正儿八经的地府在册的鬼差，虽然此刻自己没有穿制服就是了。

    正想提剑冲上去，给女鬼一个教训，可脚步刚动，看到女鬼冰冷的眼神，心底的怂意又冒了出来。

    吴姜停下脚步，轻咳了一声，说道：“这位……大姐，有话好好说。这样吧，王家有的是钱，你提条件，只要他们能够办到，我保证让他们全部答应你。只要你愿意离开王家，再也不回来惊扰他们，我就当没见过你，怎么样？”

    女鬼听到吴姜的话，脑袋依旧保持着180度的姿势，身体却缓缓旋转起来，最终恢复到了正常模样，只是那双冰冷的眼睛，依旧死死地盯着吴姜，眼神里满是嘲讽。

    “怎么？刚才不是还扬言要抓我去地府受审吗？怎么这会儿就怂了？”女鬼阴恻恻的声音响起，带着浓浓的戏谑，。

    吴姜被说得满脸通红，尴尬地咽了一口唾沫，硬着头皮说道：“那啥，凡事都有商量的余地嘛，也不是非要抓你不可。只要你离开王家，这事就翻篇了，我绝不追究。”

    “我不会走的。”女鬼的语气瞬间变得坚定而冰冷，“是他主动带我回来的，我凭什么走？你现在赶紧滚，我可以当做没见过你，不然，休怪我对你不客气！”

    吴姜知道，这次真的需要做过一场了，俗话说，先下手为强，趁女鬼不备，吴姜也顾不上心疼，催动体内魂力，手中的镇魂符瞬时飞出，朝着女鬼笼罩而去。

    女鬼本来想侧身躲开，可不知道怎么回事，身形竟莫名僵持了一下，没能及时避开，镇魂符硬生生砸在了她的身上。

    “啊——！”一声凄厉到极致的惨叫响彻整个别墅，尖锐刺耳，令人毛骨悚然。

    一楼客厅里的人，无不是吓得瑟瑟发抖，要不是王老板给的工资实在太高，他们早就收拾东西跑路了。

    吴姜此刻可顾不上一楼的众人，双眼死死地盯着女鬼，心脏怦怦直跳，心里还在暗自期盼着，希望这镇魂符能直接制消灭了女鬼。

    这就是吴姜的打斗经验不足了，换个人都知道，这个时候是需要上前补刀的。

    可是，等吴姜明白过来时，已经晚了。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Wu Jiang was furious. A ghost dared to look down on him. He was a serious ghost registered in the underworld, even though he was not wearing uniform at the moment.

He was about to rush forward with his sword and teach the female ghost a lesson, but as soon as he moved his steps, he saw the cold eyes of the female ghost, and the fear in his heart emerged again.

Wu Jiang stopped, coughed slightly, and said: "This... eldest sister, please tell me what you have to say. Let's do this. The Wang family has a lot of money. You set the conditions. As long as they can fulfill it, I promise to make them all agree to you. As long as you are willing to leave the Wang family and never come back to disturb them, I will pretend that I have never seen you. How about it?"

When the female ghost heard Wu Jiang’s words, her head still maintained a 180-degree posture, but her body slowly rotated, and finally returned to its normal appearance, but her cold eyes were still staring at Wu Jiang, full of ridicule.

"What? Didn't you just threaten to arrest me and take me to the underworld for trial? Why did you give up now?" The female ghost's sinister voice sounded, with a strong sense of teasing.

Wu Jiang's face turned red after being told that. He swallowed in embarrassment and said bravely: "Well, everything is negotiable, and I don't have to arrest you. As long as you leave the Wang family, this matter will be over, and I will never pursue it."

"I won't leave." The female ghost's tone instantly became firm and cold, "He took the initiative to bring me back, why should I leave? Get out of here now, I can pretend that I have never seen you, otherwise, don't blame me for being rude to you!"

​​ Wu Jiang knew that he really needed to do something this time. As the saying goes, strike first and take advantage of the female ghost when she is unprepared. Wu Jiang did not care about his heartache and activated the soul power in his body. The soul-suppressing talisman in his hand flew out instantly and moved towards the female ghost.

The female ghost originally wanted to dodge sideways, but for some reason, her body was in an inexplicable stalemate. She couldn't avoid it in time, and the soul-suppressing talisman hit her hard.

“Ah——!” A scream that was so shrill and shrill resounded throughout the villa, it was sharp, ear-piercing, and creepy.

The people in the living room on the first floor were all trembling with fear. If it weren’t for the high salary given by Boss Wang, they would have packed up their things and ran away.

Wu Jiang couldn't care about the people on the first floor at the moment. He stared at the female ghost with his eyes, his heart was pounding, and he was still secretly hoping that this soul-suppressing talisman could directly destroy the female ghost.

This is because Wu Jiang’s fighting experience is insufficient. Everyone knows that at this time, he needs to step forward to cover up the damage.

However, by the time Wu Jiang realized it, it was already too late.
